content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text treats a chain-weighted collision as underdetermined because no explicit textual resolution of paternity appears, which is the stating-verse test K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"Whether 'without explicit textual resolution of paternity' is a prohibited stating-verse test or merely a description of the weighing; I read K-C to bar the former when chain witnesses are pressed.","why":"The judge's stated basis for UNDERDETERMINED is the absence of an explicit textual resolution, which K-C retires as a test in chain-against-chain collisions."}
